MESSAGE.value: Remove Sebrus Apps API methods and related helpers

Resolve `$VAR` placeholders in IIS deploy payloads
Added support for resolving `$VAR` / `${VAR}` placeholders in all `iis` string fields and literal `iis.env` values during deploys, similar to Kubernetes template resolution. Updated frontend to document this behavior and revised backend logic to handle substitution before vault resolution. Introduced comprehensive tests for resolution across different config styles and edge cases. Updated documentation to reflect these changes.
Update IIS deploy flow
fixed casing and home screen loading

Add install location visibility and Thruster data location drift detection
- Expose Strongroom's installation directory in the settings screen. - Introduce tools for identifying and resolving mismatches between Strongroom's current data location and Thruster's configured path. - Update modals and UI workflows to guide users on resolving data location issues. - Extend backend logic to handle Thruster-specific data directory settings and conflicts.

Add install location display, Thruster data mismatch alerts, and pipeline path fixes
- Added a read-only install location field in settings. - Implemented Thruster data location mismatch detection with user alerts and navigation options. - Refined Azure pipeline paths for consistent lowercase directory naming.
Migrate Azure pipeline steps to PowerShell for Windows compatibility and improve cleanup/debug scripts
Add Node.js installation step to Azure pipeline for sidecar prep scripts
Improve Frappe framework fetch step in Azure pipeline: add cleanup for existing dir, handle git clone errors
Add Chocolatey installation step to Azure pipeline for missing agents
Switch OpenSSL installation in Azure pipeline to FireDaemon redistributable for improved compatibility with non-admin agents
Run migrations before doctype sync to fix ordering bug and avoid fresh DB errors; update app identifier and streamline data location logic.

Refactor module imports and reorganize `src` structure:
- Moved general entities to `core` and practice-specific elements to `practice`. - Updated module paths across the entire codebase to reflect the new structure. - Introduced `entries` module within `diary`. - Adjusted doctypes and related constants.
Add core module and embed essential Frappe DocType fixtures for standalone runtime support

Add collection fee handling, trust refund functionality, and minimum trust balance enforcement:
- Introduced settings for collection fee mode and default percentage. - Added endpoints for posting trust refunds and collection fees. - Implemented minimum trust balance validation for trust transactions. - Enhanced invoice refund logic and ledger entry reversals. - Updated docs and refactored affected modules with auto-posted collection fee support.

Add trust refunds, collection fees, and enhanced trust balance validation:
- Introduced APIs for trust refunds and collection fee posting. - Added support for minimum trust balance validation and auto-posting collection fees on trust receipts. - Expanded settings for manual/automatic collection fee modes and default collection fee percentage. - Implemented refund support for trust receipts, invoice payments, and collection fees with updated ledger entries. - Refactored modules for better extensibility and code organization.

Add integration tests for ledger features and collection fees:
- Implemented comprehensive tests for trust refunds, collection fees, and minimum trust balance validation. - Added functionality to test manual and automatic collection fee modes. - Verified disbursement blocking based on minimum trust balance. - Ensured proper handling of trust refunds and fee calculations. - Introduced `collection_fee.rs` for modular collection fee handling with effective percent resolution.

Add PR validation pipeline and e2e tests for Strongroom:
- Introduced Azure DevOps pipeline configuration for lightweight PR validation without building the full Tauri bundle. - Added e2e tests for bank reconciliation, beneficiaries, and billing modules in both TypeScript and Rust. - Implemented tests for edge cases like fuzzy matching, transaction reconciliation, CRUD operations, and CSV/OFX imports. - Ensured pipeline compatibility with non-admin Windows agents using FireDaemon OpenSSL and PowerShell scripts.

Add PR validation pipeline and comprehensive E2E deployment/test suite:
- Introduced `azure-pipelines-pr.yml` for lightweight PR validation, including cache for Cargo registry and Rust target directory. - Added E2E tests for bank reconciliation, beneficiary management, and billing functionalities. - Implemented comprehensive Rust tests for auto-matching, manual matching, and transaction imports (CSV/OFX). - Integrated OpenSSL setup via FireDaemon in the pipeline for compatibility with Windows agents.

Add end-to-end tests for bank reconciliation, beneficiaries, and billing modules:
- Introduced comprehensive E2E tests for bank reconciliation, including manual and automatic matching, unmatched transaction listing, and fuzzy matching logic. - Added beneficiary CRUD and estate filter tests to validate balance due calculations. - Implemented billing tests to verify time entry locking, invoice generation, VAT calculations, and sequential invoice numbering.

Remove outdated test files for cleanup and maintenance
Deleted legacy test files for bank reconciliation, beneficiary CRUD, and billing modules to improve code maintainability. These files were either replaced or no longer relevant to ongoing development.

Remove outdated stages and streamline pipeline configs
Removed legacy E2E and test stages from Azure pipeline to simplify CI/CD workflows. Updated project files, dependencies, and configurations for the transition from `audit_ready` to `strongroom` as the primary focus of development. Simplified outdated setups, improving maintainability and clarity.

Implement framework-wide property setters for user home page visibility
Added property setters to standardize user home page visibility across sites and updated runtime to seed these setters during initialization. Also introduced a mechanism to apply and normalize these settings dynamically in API responses and "/desk" redirects.
update build file

Add logging for custom paths and framework property seeding
Added `tracing::info` logs for `auth.custom_login_path` and `auth.custom_home_path` configurations in `config` crate. Included a log message for the `User.home_page` property seeding to enhance observability during runtime.
